notes.title: Spanish Translation Added!
notes.content:
[h2]SPANISH TRANSLATION ADDED![/h2]

Finally, 7 months after initial release of ALLBLACK Phase 1 on December 2020, Spanish translation is added! I would like to say thank you very much to [url=https://twitter.com/EstyxT]EstyX Translations[/url] who provide the Spanish translation of the story, and [url=https://www.youtube.com/kurivideosoficial]Kuri Videos[/url] who contribute the Spanish translation of the interface. Hopefully ALLBLACK will be read by more people around the world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583068/a6b7a8115e13bc7230653de88e34ad011d4ad866.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583068/78856de93567534e360b3ed57538bb5e057f2d70.png[/img]



Also, if you'd like to read the continuation, ALLBLACK Phase 2 demo is available on[url=https://nsaid.itch.io/allblack-phase-2] itch.io.[/url]. Right now I'm aiming the development time to be done on 2023, but we'll see...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583068/a5d7afcf70bf45f0e49e8e43de61b3e6e624d65c.jpg[/img]
[i]Who is this mysterious girl?[/i]

notes.title: Discord Server is Opened for Public!
notes.content:
Thank you for you who've been attending our developer Q&A chat earlier!
We decided to leave the discord server open for public discussion :D
You can join by clicking this invitation link:
https://discord.gg/pKAbDQj

Latest demo features:
[olist]
[*] Chapter 1-3 completed
[*] Partial Russian translation
[*] Updated UI and fix achievements
[/olist]

Regarding ALLBLACK Phase 1 status and development:
[list]
[*] Completion status: 5 chapter finished, chapter 6 is ongoing 
[*] Chapter 1 is underway major editing
[*] Estimation of release date is around mid November - December 2020
[/list]
